Report Description
*****CORRECTION TO INITIAL WEB REPORT 993085*****M/V ALBATROSS IV ALONGSIDE LAYBERTH AT NORTH FLORIDA SHIPYARDS, JACKSONVILLE, FL. RECEIVING DIESEL FUEL DELIVERY/TRANSFER FROM 2 SHORESIDE TANK TRUCKS. DECLARATION OF SECURITY AND FUEL TRANSFER PROCEDURES WERE AGREED UPON, CHIEF ENGR ON DUTY WITH 4 CREWMEMBERS STANDING BY ASSISTING. IT WAS OBSERVED THAT FUEL BEGAN TO LEAK OUT OF ONE OF THE TRUCKS AND OPERATIONS WERE IMMEDIATELY SHUTDOWN. CONTAINMENT ABSORBENT PADS WERE RUN OUT AND A SMALL AMOUNT OF DIESEL DROOLED OVER THE EDGE OF THE DOCK INTO THE ST. JOHNS RIVER (APPROX 5GALS) IN MY ESTIMATION THE ENTIRE SPILL WAS APPROX. 20-25 GALS. TOTAL. THE FACT THAT THE ABSORBENT PADS AND BOOM WERE AVAILABLE KEPT IT FROM REACHING THE WATER IN GREATER VOLUME. I WAS UP IN THE VESSELS WHEELHOUSE AND BECAME AWARE OF THE INCIDENT @ APPROX 1730 EDST. AFTER MAKING CERTAIN THAT ALL TRANSFER OPERATIONS WERE SHUTDOWN AND WOULD NOT CONTINUE, I REPORTED THIS INCIDENT TO JACKSONVILLE USCG SECTOR AND WAS TRANSFERRED TO NRC

READINGS ALL CLEAR AT OTHER LOCATIONS. 3 PEOPLE HOSPITALIZED, 1 HELD OVER NIGHT FOR OBSERVATION, 2 RELEASED.
